::: {.recap}
**Where we are.** Module 2 needs P and R. This module asks one question: *Without a model, how do we learn values and policies from experience?*
:::

## What you will build {#build}

In this module you will:

- Measure the RMS error, squared bias and variance of MC and TD(0) estimates over 10 seeds against the exact V.
- Implement SARSA and Q-learning and explain the cliff contrast under a constant epsilon.
- Diagnose a terminal-bootstrap bug from a learning curve and the Q-values.
- Compute n-step TD targets and place them between MC and TD.

## Before you start {#before}

- [Module 2 · Planning: value iteration, policy iteration and model error](/modules/02-planning.qmd) and its lab: this module builds on what it left open.

- No API keys or paid services.
